subject.title: [security] Share-visible lease GET exposes Daytona SSH access token

question: Should `manage` share recipients receive direct Daytona SSH access credentials from single-lease JSON responses, or should Daytona credentials be owner/admin-only while shared users use portal-mediated access?
rationale: Source confirms `use` share disclosure, but `manage` credential semantics are a security-boundary policy choice that docs do not currently settle.

options.title: Owner/admin only credentials
options.body: Redact Daytona `sshUser` for every non-owner non-admin caller and keep shared users on portal-mediated access unless a credential-sharing feature is explicitly designed.

options.title: Manage gets credentials
options.body: Allow `manage` share recipients to receive Daytona credentials but redact for `use`, with tests and docs making that elevated role meaning explicit.

recommendation.title: Owner/admin only credentials
recommendation.body: Redact Daytona `sshUser` for every non-owner non-admin caller and keep shared users on portal-mediated access unless a credential-sharing feature is explicitly designed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Worker security and diagnostic credential-redaction commits make this the best available owner for the boundary decision.
